lines.text: The three medians of a triangle meet at one point, G.
lines.caption: The three medians of a triangle meet at one point, G.

lines.text: Draw a line through G, parallel to the base. How long is it?
lines.caption: Draw a line through G, parallel to the base. How long is it?

lines.text: The base B C is twenty-four. E F goes through G, parallel to B C.
lines.caption: The base B C is twenty-four. E F goes through G, parallel to B C.

lines.text: Here's the secret. G is two thirds of the way down each median.
lines.caption: Here's the secret. G is two thirds of the way down each median.

lines.text: So shrink the whole triangle toward A, to two thirds size.
lines.caption: So shrink the whole triangle toward A, to two thirds size.

lines.text: Side B C lands right on E F. Every length becomes two thirds.
lines.caption: Side B C lands right on E F. Every length becomes two thirds.

lines.text: Two thirds of twenty-four is sixteen!
lines.caption: Two thirds of twenty-four is sixteen!

lines.text: Not twelve. G is two thirds down, not halfway.
lines.caption: Not twelve. G is two thirds down, not halfway.
